This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a [[Chirality (mathematics)|chiral]] symmetric arrangement of 4 [[triangular prism]]s, aligned with the axes of three-fold [[rotational symmetry]] of an [[octahedron]].

== Cartesian coordinates ==
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of this compound are all the [[even permutation]]s of

: (±1, ±(1+{{radic|2}}), ±(1−{{radic|2}}))

with an even number of minuses in the '±' choices, together with all the odd permutations with an odd number of minuses in the '±' choices.
